thread.title: Apple blocks Google from internal iOS apps over misuse: reports

author: Mike Murphy
title: Apple blocks Google from internal iOS apps over misuse: reports
text: Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.86% briefly blocked Alphabet's GOOGL, +0.11% GOOG, +0.20% Google from distributing internal iOS apps following reports that a Google app improperly harvested user data, according to multiple reports Thursday. The suspension of its developer certificate was similar to one handed to Facebook Inc. FB, -0.17% on Wednesday after a report that it paid users to install an app that gave Facebook access to virtually all their online data . Facebook's ban only lasted a day though . Google's suspension lasted mere hours; T echCrunch reported Thursday night that its certificate had already been restored.
